cases.description: Synthetic fixture labeled front.jpg / FRONT 3/4 VIEW shows abstract dark vehicle silhouette on blue grid with red banner 'SYNTHETIC FIXTURE IS NOT A REAL VEHICLE'; no front radar, grille sensor, bumper sensor, windshield camera, or cruise hardware is visible.
Same synthetic fixture shows abstract silhouette only; no windshield lane camera, lane markings, steering wheel, or lane keeping button/interface is discernible.

Synthetic fixture labeled interior.png / DASHBOARD/CONTROLS shows identical abstract dark silhouette on green grid with 'SYNTHETIC FIXTURE IS NOT A REAL VEHICLE' banner; no dashboard, steering wheel controls, instrument cluster, or adaptive cruise buttons visible.
Same synthetic placeholder on green grid shows no interior detail, no steering wheel, no lane assist button, no windshield camera, and no driver-assist display.

Synthetic fixture labeled wheel.webp / WHEEL+SENSOR AREA shows abstract dark silhouette on brown grid with 'SYNTHETIC FIXTURE IS NOT A REAL VEHICLE' banner; no wheel, tire, wheel well sensor, or ADAS hardware detail visible.
Same synthetic placeholder on brown grid shows only abstract silhouette with two solid wheel circles; no lane keeping sensor, camera, or related hardware is visible.
